wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/eval_chunks.sh: #!/bin/zsh
# `codegen::eval::` alone is 972 tests, each compiling AND linking a PHP program. Run whole, it
# outlives the background-task horizon and gets killed with nothing written — four times so far.
# Split by name prefix so every chunk finishes in a few minutes, and RESUME: a chunk already in
# the verdict file is skipped.
#
# The last chunk is defined by EXCLUSION (--skip of every prefix above it) so no test can fall
# between the named ones. Their counts are summed at the end against the 972 the binary lists,
# which is what turns "looks covered" into "is covered".
